nullSemantics: vitest omits "<n> failed" / "<n> skipped" from the summary when the count is 0, so null in files.failed / files.skipped / tests.failed means "reporter did not print it" and is treated as 0 for the verdict. No line is ever invented: if the "Test Files" / "Tests" summary line itself were missing, verdict is NOT_PERFORMED.

skippedIdentity.evidence: the default reporter prints only the skipped COUNT, not the names; identity confirmed by a separate targeted run `npx vitest run src/game/ai/__tests__/boundedPlanRefutation.test.ts --reporter=verbose -t "G0.3W"` => 9 passed | 4 skipped, the 4 being G0.3W-4..7 under "G0.3W real-corpus regression (G4 / G1)" (ctx.skip(), missing corpus). Same 4 skips exist on the P1 baseline (1026-test run) and are environment-independent.
